title: The Iliad
author: Various
content:
English-language translations of Ἰλιάς include:


== Complete works ==
The Iliads of Homer Prince of Poetts, Translated according to the Greeke (1611), translated by George Chapman
The Iliad of Homer (1715–1720), translated by Alexander Pope
The Iliad of Homer... (1856), translated by Francis William Newman
The Iliad of Homer (1860), translated by Theodore Alois Buckley
The Iliad of Homer... (1864), translated by Edward George Geoffrey Smith-Stanley, the Earl of Derby (external scans (multiple parts): 1, 2)
The Iliad of Homer, Done into English Prose (1883), translated by Lang, Leaf, and Myers IA
The Iliad of Homer... (1898), translated by Samuel Butler (transcription project)
The Iliad of Homer, Done into English Prose, revised edition (1911), translated by Lang, Leaf, and Myers IA
The Iliad (1924), translated by Augustus Taber Murray for the Loeb Classical Library


== Retellings ==
The Story of the Iliad (1895), translated and adapted by Alfred John Church


== Partial works ==
Homer his Iliads (1660), translated by John Ogilby
Homer's Iliads (1676), translated by Thomas Hobbes, edited and possibly paraphrased by William Molesworth (1839–45) (transcription project)
The parting of Hector with his Princess Andromache, and only Son Astyanax (1695), translated by Knightly Chetwood (from Book 6)
The First Book of Homer's Ilias (1700), translated by John Dryden
Part of the Tenth Book of the Iliads of Homer. In the Stile of Milton (1739), translated by William Broome
From the Eleventh Book of the Iliads of Homer. In the Stile of Milton (1739), translated by William Broome
The Iliad of Homer (1773), translated by James Macpherson
The first Book of The Iliad (1781), translated by Thomas Tickell
The Iliad of Homer (1791), translated by William Cowper
The Iliad of Homer (1865), translation of the first 12 books by Philip Stanhope Worsley
Translations of Iliad (1869), translation of lines 1-32 and 121-218 of Book I., by Arthur Hugh Clough
The Iliad of Homer... (1870), translated by William Cullen Bryant (transcription project)


== Commentary ==
The Iliad (1871), by William Lucas Collins
"Iliad," in Collier's New Encyclopedia, New York: P. F. Collier & Son Co. (1921)
